# M04 table references and synthetic OCR fixtures

`golden.json` contains small manually transcribed reference rows from rendered
authentic PDFs, inspected on 2026-10-09 before these assertions were written:
Bakery Products (PSRID 79), physical page 2; Book Binding (156), physical page 8;
Hand Made Paper from Waste (709), physical page 10. Values were read visually from
the source pages, not generated by the table parser. The originals remain local
under `data/raw/`; SHA identities bind every reference. No normalization is
applied to numeric cell strings. Government-content redistribution remains
REVIEW REQUIRED. Full rendered pages are ignored under `data/work/m04-review/`.

`scripts/check_m04_ocr.py::synthetic_pdf` generates an explicitly synthetic ruled
table with a blank amount and a raster-only page with printed reference text.
The mixed fixture combines them. These are not authentic PMEGP documents. The
separate acceptance command must run real Tesseract and recover the known text;
mocked unit tests do not satisfy that gate. Missing runtime returns exit 2.
